canonicalCleanupPolicy.intent: Official published SWSE playable species only in the canonical species compendium
canonicalCleanupPolicy.statusSemantics: MARKED_FOR_REMOVAL means an explicit candidate selected for the controlled cleanup queue, NOT deleted or determined fictional in Star Wars lore.
canonicalCleanupPolicy.exceptionPolicy: If an independently verified official SWSE playable racial rules block is recovered for a candidate, review or clear its removal designation before deletion.

cloneWars2009CrossCheck.searchCorpus: Original user-supplied scanned 225-page PDF, searchable supplied Clone Wars Campaign Guide_djvu.txt; PDF Chapter I scanned/inspected; NPC/Republic/Confederacy/planet passages searched
cloneWars2009CrossCheck.claimedOfficialFandomGeonosianListCaveat: CWCG_Species fandom index lists Geonosian, but the PDF Chapter I table/main species traits sequence has no Geonosian racial block; Geonosian appears in official NPC/planet material and an earlier Wizards conversion guide. Separate source-profile version check, not removal queue.

removalDecisionSchema.decision: Keep 17 fan-attributed species marked for removal. Do not delete or hide until a separate approved production patch.
gates: Dependency inventory across saved actors, sidecars, registry and CharGen
